name: a pointed question with a live timestamp in the corner
looks: A short, direct line types on in a warm serif, addressing the viewer by role. A tiny timestamp sits quietly in the top corner, ticking forward in real time, independent of the words.
build: Headline revealed with kit.typeOn; the timestamp is a monospace DOM text block set from the live clock with no easing, same mechanic as live-readout-hud, low contrast so it never competes with the headline.
sound: A light typing clack per character, otherwise silent.
prompt: Type on a short, direct line addressing the viewer by their role, with a tiny live timestamp ticking quietly in the corner of the frame, independent of the words, to suggest a story happening in real time.
